message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s authorities.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to Do | Contact Info |
|------|------------|--------------|
| **1** | Identify the source of the noise (e.g., residential, commercial, construction) | – |
| **2** | Call the City of Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** (or dial 911 only if it’s an emergency). | 404‑656‑4000 |
| **3** | If you prefer online, visit the City’s official website and use the “Noise Complaint” form under the Department of Public Safety. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/department-of-public-safety |
| **4** | Provide details: address, time(s) of disturbance, description of the noise, and any evidence (photos, audio recordings). | – |
| **5** | Receive a reference number; follow up if you don’t hear back within a few days. | – |

The City’s Department of Public Safety handles most noise complaints, but if the issue involves a business or a violation of city ordinances, they may forward your report to the appropriate zoning or code enforcement office.
